meta.name: CreateACal
meta.notes: Deep audit 2026-09-13 from calendar repo + createacal-www. Commerce/PrintCheck gate not shipped.

positioning.oneLiner: Everyone's dates. Everyone's photos. One beautiful calendar.
positioning.differentiator: Intake → face tag → mosaic QC → print PDF — not a Canva collage alone.

objectionsAndAnswers.objection: We can just use a photo book site.
objectionsAndAnswers.answer: CreateACal is built for multi-contributor dates + photos with print QC, not a solo design session.
